AMAZON_CONFIG_INVALID: The Amazon stage configuration is not valid.
AMAZON_CONFIG_MISSING: The Amazon stage configuration is missing.
AMAZON_EVENT_TIME_INVALID: An order event has an invalid time.
None; the event is left out.
AMAZON_GMAIL_LIST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The Gmail list hit its page limit before finishing.
AMAZON_GMAIL_READBACK_MISMATCH: A Gmail message did not read back as expected.
AMAZON_INTERNAL_FAILED: An unexpected error inside the Amazon stage.
AMAZON_NOTION_DUPLICATE_ORDER: Two Notion rows hold the same order id.
AMAZON_NOTION_FAILED: A Notion call in the Amazon stage failed.
AMAZON_NOTION_PAGINATION_INCOMPLETE: A Notion list did not finish paging.
AMAZON_NOTION_QUERY_INCOMPLETE: A Notion query returned an incomplete result.
AMAZON_NOTION_QUERY_MISMATCH: A Notion query returned a different row than asked.
AMAZON_NOTION_READBACK_FAILED: A written row could not be read back.
AMAZON_NOTION_READBACK_MISMATCH: A written row did not read back as written.
AMAZON_NOTION_ROW_INVALID: A Notion order row is not valid.
AMAZON_NOTION_SCHEMA_INVALID: The Notion Amazon database schema is not valid.
AMAZON_NOTION_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: The database no longer has the properties the stage writes.
AMAZON_NOTION_SCHEMA_READ_FAILED: The database schema could not be read.
AMAZON_NOTION_VALUE_INVALID: A value cannot be written to its Notion property.
AMAZON_NOTION_VALUE_TOO_LONG: A value is over Notion's length limit.
AMAZON_NOW_INVALID: The clock value passed in is not a time.
AMAZON_TOTAL_INVALID: An order total is not a number.
CARD_PAGINATION_INCOMPLETE: A card list did not finish paging.
CARD_READ_FAILED: The card could not be read.
CARD_READ_INCOMPLETE: The card read did not finish.
CARD_ROW_INVALID: A card row is not valid.
DUPLICATE_EVENT_CONFLICT: Two events for one order disagree, so the order goes to review.
DUPLICATE_ROWS: More than one row exists for an order.
EVENT_INVALID: An order event is not valid.
EVENT_TIME_INVALID: An event time is not valid.
PACKAGES_GMAIL_FAILED: The other-store packages could not be read from Gmail; the Amazon section is unaffected.
ORDER_ALREADY_REVIEW: The order is already in review.
ORDER_ID_AMBIGUOUS: A mail names more than one order id, so it goes to review.
ORDER_ID_MISSING: A mail names no order id, so it goes to review.
REVIEW_AGED: An order has sat in review past the age limit.
SENDER_UNSUPPORTED: The sender is not supported, so the mail goes to review.
STATUS_INVALID: An order status is not valid.
TOTAL_CONFLICT: Two mails give different order totals, so the order goes to review.
TOTAL_INVALID: An order total is not a number, so it goes to review.
TOTAL_PENDING: An order total is still pending.
URL_CONFLICT: Two events give different order links, so the order goes to review.
